summary: Backend-only audit for Etapa 2 (Cimitir sync + web admin + public map). Ran the full backend pytest suite (61/61 passing, including all 16 test_etapa2_sync.py end-to-end tests that spin up isolated uvicorn servers and desktop MAIN clients). Additionally did live smoke tests against the preview URL for the key protocol contracts (sync auth, regression endpoints).

minor.issue: PendingDeprecationWarning: `import python_multipart` should replace `import multipart` (framework-level, non-blocking; same as iteration_3).

critical_code_review_comments: Public projection (`/api/public/map`, `/loc/{cod}`, `/search`, `/cerere/{cod}`) is well-isolated from personal data; the test_server_keeps_only_explicit_public_fields test asserts extras (cnp/adresa/concesionar/top-level concesionari) never leak — the SQLite dump is also inspected. Contract worth keeping locked down going forward.

Version/hash conflict semantics on POST /api/sync/map are correct: lower map_version -> 409 stale; equal version with different snapshot_hash -> 409 conflict; equal version + same hash -> 200 duplicate:true. Public map unchanged after rejected pushes (verified).

Availability is decoupled from burials and contract expiry (test_availability_is_independent_of_burials_and_contract_expiry). Rejected /api/public/cerere on indisponibil plots returns 409; accepted ones return CR-* codes.

Requests ack correctly redacts nume/prenume/cnp/adresa/telefon/email server-side while public tracking (only 5 keys) still works; status transitions enforce version + op_id (replay dedup, older version -> 409, invalid status -> 422/400).
Web-admin RBAC (admin vs operator with edit-only vs user) enforced; last-admin protection and self-delete protection tested. Deactivated user session invalidated on next request.
Sync-key isolation across cemeteries verified: swapping suffix/prefix between two cemetery keys yields 401; local-mode server rejects sync endpoints with 404.
Rate limiting / brute-force protection on /admin/access/login and /api/sync/* still missing (noted as known-not-a-bug in review-request).
test_credentials: admin/admin123, user/user123, source_id=cimitir; sync key via `python /app/scripts/issue_sync_key.py` (rotates on each call).
seed_data_creation: No writes to preview DB. All Etapa 2 tests use isolated tmp_path folders (fresh uvicorn + fresh MAIN client per test). portal_requests_enabled left at 1 on the preview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview smoke-checks confirmed live: /api/sync/ping returns 401 without/with wrong X-Sync-Key and 200 {ok,cemetery_id,map_version,lease_hours} with a valid key issued via scripts/issue_sync_key.py; /api/sync/staff returns staff list w/ password_hash and lease_hours; regression endpoints /api/public/health, /search, /map, /loc, /cerere all 200; /api/admin/map.json anonymous -> 401. NOTE: running scripts/issue_sync_key.py invalidates the previous key — main agent should reissue when handing off. The 16-tests suite in test_etapa2_sync.py exhaustively covers: MAIN->online map push with version bumps + delete propagation, uncalibrated-scale hides suprafata/laturi, background+sectors+scale published, availability independent of burials & expired contracts, offline resume without duplicates, interrupted sync keeps operations & MAIN keeps working, old-version stale + snapshot conflict rejection, stale MAIN reports error and does not publish, extras/PII stripping (also asserted directly in SQLite), requests pull/ack/decision/replay with server-side redact, request document (PDF) upload reaching MAIN, staff sync + lease + revocation + reconnect + expired-lease behavior, live rights re-check in desktop, web-admin rights revocation + config toggle (portal_requests_enabled -> 503, offline_lease_hours reflected in /api/sync/staff, last-admin/self-delete protection), sync auth isolation across cemeteries + local-mode 404, MAIN refuses keys of another cemetery + http-remote insecure URL refusal. No defects.
